about.title: Built to make AI skill legible
about.body: MyAmbii is a product built on the flAIr future Intelligence platform by Mukaab Technologies Private Limited. We believe hiring for AI should rest on demonstrated ability rather than keywords on a résumé — so we verify skills through real assessments, with select skills confirmed through a recorded conversation reviewed by a person, and give employers evidence they can check.
